description: Export masked LMS assignment reporting in CSV, JSON, or JSONL, including mastery run-budget columns. CSV/JSONL are spreadsheet-neutralized. delivery=inline (default) returns ONE bounded page in structuredContent (cursor + limit to page). delivery=resource walks EVERY page from cursor on and returns a compact receipt (rowCount, pages, startCursor, complete, byteSize, sha256, contentType, resourceUri) plus a resource_link; the rows never enter the result — read opentrain://lms/jobs/{jobId}/assignments/export/{format} when you need the bytes (limit is then the walk page size). The whole artifact is bounded at 20 MiB, checked after each page. There is NO snapshot: the resource read re-walks the LIVE export, so its _meta.sha256 equals the receipt hash only if no row changed in between — a different hash means the rows changed; re-run the tool for a fresh receipt. Cost: the receipt is ~0.03x the inline page walk, but receipt + read is larger than the walk; use resource when you need only the receipt or your host keeps resource bytes out of your context. Requires lms:read.
name: opentrain_lms_export_assignments
